A service or port allowed through firewalld, now and after reboots.

```hcl
step "example" {
  firewalld {
    port = "..."
  }
}
```

## Arguments

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `on_remove` | string | No | "delete" (default) closes the port again when the rule is removed or replaced, "forget" leaves it open. |
| `port` | string | No | Port and protocol, such as 8080/tcp or 60000-61000/udp. Set this or service. |
| `service` | string | No | firewalld service name, such as http. Set this or port. |
| `zone` | string | No | Zone. Defaults to firewalld's default zone. |

## Read-only attributes

Conn3x sets these; reference them as `conn3x_firewalld.<circuit>__<step>["<host>"].<name>`.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `in_sync` | bool | Whether the running and permanent firewall both allow it. |

A step lowers to the `conn3x_firewalld` resource, one instance per host, and connects with its circuit's `ssh` block.
